en: Genesis 35

zh: 上帝在伯特利賜福雅各

p.src: 1  God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

en: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”
u.src: 1  God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

p.src: 2  Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

ja: 族と、彼と一緒にいるすべての
en: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.
u.src: 2  Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

p.src: 3  Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

en: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”
u.src: 3  Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

p.src: 4  They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

ja: した。ヤコブはそれらを、シェケムのそばにある
en: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
u.src: 4  They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

p.src: 5  They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

en: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
u.src: 5  They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

p.src: 6  So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

ja: こうして、ヤコブと彼と一緒にいたすべての民は、カナンの
にあるルズ、すなわちベテルに
en: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
u.src: 6  So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

p.src: 7  He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

ja: をエル・ベテルと呼んだ。
en: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
u.src: 7  He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

ja: 35:7 エル・ベテルは「ベテルの神」を意味する。
zh: 35:7 就是伯特利之上帝的意思

p.src: 8  Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

ja: られた。その名はアロン・バクテと
en: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
u.src: 8  Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

ja: 35:8 アロン・バクテは「泣きの樫の木」を意味する。

p.src: 9  God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

ja: ヤコブがパダン・アラムから
en: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
u.src: 9  God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

p.src: 10  God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

ja: はヤコブである。あなたの
ばれず、あなたの名はイスラエルとなる。」
en: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.
u.src: 10  God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

p.src: 11  God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

ja: 族の集まりがあなたから
たちがあなたの体から
en: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
u.src: 11  God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

p.src: 12  The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

ja: わたしがアブラハムとイサクに
en: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”
u.src: 12  The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

p.src: 13  God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

en: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
u.src: 13  God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

p.src: 14  Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

ja: てた。彼はその上に飲み物のささげ物を注ぎ、その
en: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
u.src: 14  Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

p.src: 15  Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

ja: の名をベテルと呼んだ。
en: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
u.src: 15  Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

p.src: 16  They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

ja: った。エフラテに着くまでにはまだ
し距離があったが、ラケルは
en: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
u.src: 16  They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

p.src: 17  When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

ja: れないでください。この子も
en: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”
u.src: 17  When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

p.src: 18  As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

en: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
u.src: 18  As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

ja:
35:18 ベン・オニは「私の悲しみの息子」を意味する。
35:18 ベニヤミンは「右手の息子」を意味する。
en:
35:18 “Benoni” means “son of my trouble”.
35:18 “Benjamin” means “son of my right hand”.

p.src: 19  Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

ja: に、エフラテ、すなわちベツレヘムへの
en: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
u.src: 19  Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

p.src: 20  Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

ja: てた。これは今日に至るまで、ラケルの
en: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
u.src: 20  Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

p.src: 21  Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

en: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
u.src: 21  Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

p.src: 22  While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

ja: んでいたとき、ルベンは
のそばめであるビルハと
た。イスラエルはそれを
いた。 さて、ヤコブの息
en: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
u.src: 22  While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

p.src: 23  The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

ja: 男ルベン、シメオン、レビ、ユダ、イッサカル、ゼブルン。
en: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
u.src: 23  The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

p.src: 24  The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

ja: たちは、ヨセフ、ベニヤミン。
en: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
u.src: 24  The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

p.src: 25  The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

en: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
u.src: 25  The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

p.src: 26  The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

ja: たちは、ガド、アシェル。これらは、パダン・アラムでヤコブに
en: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
u.src: 26  The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

p.src: 27  Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

ja: ヤコブは、アブラハムとイサクが寄留していたマムレ、キルヤト・アルバ、すなわちヘブロンにいる父イサクのところへ行った。
en: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.
u.src: 27  Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

p.src: 28  The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

en: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
u.src: 28  The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

p.src: 29  Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

ja: って死に、老いて長寿を全うし、自分の
en: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
u.src: 29  Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
